subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Mac hasn't looked at the board once: the star chart in one hand, a pencil in the other, nose to the big window. Hamond has come up behind him with a covered pot and a ladle, and is explaining the sky to it as if it were a table of guests. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: The Big Window). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
